why_agent_cannot: log in or create the account (human session)
what_human_must_do: Log in / create the account in the shared profile, then the agent can continue.
steps_from_source: Check that your country is on DuelBet's service availability list and not on the licence's excluded list (see risks below). Don't use a VPN: the terms ban it.
Type duelbet.com yourself and create an account. You must be "at least 18 years old and have reached the higher legal gambling age" where you live.

Deposit crypto through the cashier. Send it on the network the cashier shows: "Funds sent to an unsupported network or incorrect address may be permanently lost." Warning Set a loss limit before you start. Points scale with the amount you bet, so chasing a race rank means chasing losses.
Play eligible games. Points are credited automatically and you are entered in the daily and monthly races.
If you place in a race, choose cash (which burns the points) or keep the points for the planned airdrop.
Watch @duelbetcasino on X and t.me/duel_bet for any snapshot or TGE news. There is no $DUEL contract yet, so any "$DUEL" token you see trading is not DuelBet's.
